description.value: Church Street Bakery is an authentic artisan bakery and wood-fired pizzeria that has anchored downtown Comox since 2009, built around the Comox Valley's only traditional wood-fired brick oven. The shop produces hand-crafted sourdough breads using organic BC-milled flours, thin-crust pizzas, pastries, and fresh soups and sandwiches daily. Part of the Union Foods Group, it sits a short walk from the Comox Marina and serves espresso and craft beer on tap alongside its baked goods.
